movie_title: Talking about travel 🚴🚗🚆 Real Easy English: Episode 9
introduction: Learn how to talk about your journey to work in simple English. Visit our website for more 👉 https:/

vocabulary.definition: the act of traveling from one place to another
vocabulary.example: My journey to work takes me one hour if I walk.

vocabulary.definition: located, occurring, or taking place below the surface of the ground
vocabulary.example: The tube is the underground train that I take to work.

vocabulary.definition: a situation in which a long line of vehicles on a road have stopped moving or are moving very slowly
vocabulary.example: The bus journey takes a long time due to the traffic jam.

vocabulary.definition: a period of the day when traffic is at its heaviest
vocabulary.example: During rush hour, the roads are busier as most people are going to work.

vocabulary.definition: reducing tension or anxiety; restful; soothing
vocabulary.example: Your journey to work sounds more relaxing than mine.

vocabulary.definition: a written text of a play, movie, or broadcast
vocabulary.example: You can find a script of this podcast on our website for reading along.
